english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had with you, without good reason or lawful authority, in a public place **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)

(A)_[an article which had a blade or was sharply pointed, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..).]_
(B)_[a folding pocket knife which had a blade the cutting edge of which exceeded 7.62 centimetres (3 inches).]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 139(1) and (6) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Four years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
